title: Why AI Agents Are Everywhere
full_monologue: Every tech giant is racing to build AI agents, and here's why. These intelligent systems are the future of automation, personalization, and efficiency. They can manage tasks, learn from data, and even interact with users in real-time. **This is the next big leap in AI.** We're seeing AI agents in customer service, healthcare, and even self-driving cars. They’re not just tools—they’re becoming partners in our digital lives. But what does this mean for the future of work? Let me know in the comments.
